title: Lance Bass' twins inherited his Christmas decorating passion: 'Definitely in the genes'

 Lance Bass is ready to get festive!
 LOS ANGELES, CALIFORNIA - NOVEMBER 16: Lance Bass attends the 25th Anniversary Celebration of Christmas at the Grove on November 16, 2026 in Los Angeles, California. (Photo by Michael Tullberg/Getty Images) 
 The *NSYNC singer hosted the 25th Anniversary Celebration of Christmas at The Grove on Monday night in Los Angeles and was fully in the Christmas spirits.
 “This is the way I start my you know my holiday season with this event,” he told PauseRewind’s Elizabeth Stanton of his third outing as host.
 He continued, “And what's great is this is the first event I ever took my kids to when they were born, right after COVID. So this has really become an amazing like Christmas tradition for all of us.”
 Bass is known for his decadent decorations at Halloween and Christmas, a passion his twins, Alexander James and Violet Betty, have inherited. “Definitely in the genes,” Bass said.
 “My kids, especially my son, got the decorating bug. They love the holidays just as much as I do. So every day they get up like, ‘No, no, no, I'm gonna move this over here. And I think the tree needs to go [here],’ so they're constantly just rearranging everything,” he said with a laugh.
 “So their head is going to explode when they see all of this. Especially my son, he's going to just die,” Bass said of the festivities at The Grove.
 Lance Bass at the 25th Annual Christmas at The Grove Tree Lighting Celebration on November 16, 2026 in Los Angeles, California. (Photo by Mark Von Holden/Variety via Getty Images) 
 Bass also recently authored a Christmas book for kids, “The Legend of Mrs. Claws.”
 “It's the little black cat from my first book, [“Trick or Treat on Scary Street”], and it was inspired by my kids because they are obsessed with the cats,” he shared. “We don't even have a cat, but since they were born, they just loved cats. So I said, ‘I have to write a children's book for you, using a cat.’ So it just perfectly worked out.”
 The *NSYNC member, who memorably handled the bass portions of the group’s harmonies, also addressed his recent admission that he sometimes forgets their lyrics.
 “I mean, everyone's pretty good at it except me,” Bass said. “I just have a horrible memory. I have such ADHD that my brain is always everywhere. So it's yeah, it misfires a lot. Sorry. That's why I do teleprompter these days. Just give me a teleprompter. I'm good to go!”
 “The Legend of Mrs. Claws” is available now.
